title: Device identity & QR lifecycle
description: Associate a unique QR with each device and show its lifecycle events.
excerpt: The synthetic Lifecycle Core configuration supports a unique device QR linked to lifecycle events. QR possession does not grant access to private records.
criteria: Scanning an authorised device QR opens only that device’s lifecycle record.
An unauthorised scan does not expose restricted records.
pitch_hinglish: Har device ka QR uski authorised lifecycle history se link kar sakte hain.

customer_response.Hindi: हर डिवाइस का QR उसके इतिहास से जुड़ सकता है। केवल अधिकृत रिकॉर्ड दिखाई देंगे।
customer_response.Hinglish: Har device ka QR uski lifecycle history se link ho sakta hai; sirf authorised records dikhenge.

title: Central repair & diagnostics
description: Retain repair and diagnostic events against the device identity.
excerpt: Lifecycle Core stores dated repair and diagnostic events per device, including service-partner attribution. Events are visible only to authorised roles.
criteria: An authorised service user can add a dated diagnostic event.
The device timeline displays authorised repair events with attribution.
pitch_hinglish: Repair aur diagnostic records ek jagah rakh sakte hain.

customer_response.Hindi: मरम्मत और जाँच के रिकॉर्ड एक जगह रखे जा सकते हैं।
customer_response.Hinglish: Repair aur diagnostic records ek jagah rakh sakte hain.

title: Partner access & owner privacy
requirement: Restrict repair-partner access and protect owner personal data
description: Partners may access relevant device repair records only; original-owner personal information must remain hidden.
excerpt: Partner access requires configured role policies and permission tests. Partners see assigned device service records, never original-owner personal information. Public QR views exclude personal data.
criteria: A repair-partner account can view assigned device service records.
Owner name, contact details and identity data are absent from partner responses and views.
A partner cannot retrieve unassigned records by changing a device ID.
questions: Which partner roles and assignment rules are required?
pitch_hinglish: Partner ko sirf assigned service records dikhenge; owner personal information hidden rahegi, role configuration aur permission testing ke baad.

customer_response.Hindi: पार्टनर को केवल संबंधित रिकॉर्ड दिखेंगे। मालिक की व्यक्तिगत जानकारी नहीं दिखेगी। इसके लिए भूमिका विन्यास और अनुमति परीक्षण ज़रूरी हैं।
customer_response.Hinglish: Partner ko sirf assigned service records dikhenge; owner ki personal information hidden rahegi. Role configuration aur permission testing zaroori hai.

title: ERP integration prerequisites
description: Assess ERP integration compatibility before making a commitment.
excerpt: ERP integration is conditional on accessible APIs, authentication, field mapping, vendor/version compatibility and sandbox testing. No universal ERP connector, fixed delivery date or compatibility guarantee is approved.
criteria: Record ERP vendor/version, API documentation and authentication method.
Validate field mapping and a create/update flow in a sandbox before approving integration.
questions: What is the ERP vendor/version, and are API documentation and a sandbox available?
pitch_hinglish: ERP integration API availability aur compatibility review par depend karega.

customer_response.Hindi: ERP जोड़ना API उपलब्धता और संगतता (compatibility) पर निर्भर है। पहले API, फ़ील्ड मैपिंग और सैंडबॉक्स परीक्षण की समीक्षा होगी।
customer_response.Hinglish: ERP integration API availability aur compatibility par depend karega. Authentication, field mapping aur sandbox testing pehle validate karenge.

title: Volume & capacity validation
requirement: Validate capacity against expected device volume
description: Clarify monthly device volume, peak concurrency and growth before confirming capacity.
excerpt: No throughput guarantee is approved. Monthly device volume, peak concurrency, event counts and retention must be established and load tested. Pricing is not documented.
criteria: Document current and target monthly volume and peak concurrency.
Agree and run a representative load test before a capacity commitment.
questions: What are current/target volume, peak concurrency and retention needs?
pitch_hinglish: Capacity ko workload definition aur load testing se validate karna hoga; abhi guarantee nahi hai.

customer_response.Hindi: क्षमता का वादा अभी नहीं कर सकते। मासिक संख्या और अधिकतम उपयोग स्पष्ट करके लोड परीक्षण करना होगा।
customer_response.Hinglish: Volume ke liye abhi guarantee nahi hai. Monthly volume aur peak usage clarify karke load testing karni hogi.

title: Unsupported scope & prohibited claims
description: Clarify alternatives because fully offline operation is outside this demo configuration.
excerpt: Fully offline synchronisation, biometric identification, automatic ERP compatibility and guaranteed zero downtime are outside the synthetic product scope. Never promise any ERP, unlimited capacity, security certifications or undocumented pricing.
criteria: Explain that fully offline operation is outside this configuration.
Ask whether a connected workflow is acceptable.
pitch_hinglish: Fully offline operation is configuration mein supported nahi hai.

customer_response.Hindi: पूरी तरह ऑफलाइन काम करना इस कॉन्फ़िगरेशन में उपलब्ध नहीं है।
customer_response.Hinglish: Fully offline operation is configuration mein supported nahi hai.

title: Lifecycle Core + Partner Access configuration
excerpt: Synthetic configurable B2B device-lifecycle platform. Lifecycle Core combines device QR identity and central service history. Partner Access adds restricted service-partner workflows, conditional on access-policy setup. ERP discovery is an assessment, not a guaranteed connector. No real EcoXchange deployment claims.

title: Approved discovery & objection playbook
excerpt: Acknowledge concerns, explain documented fit, preserve limitations, then ask one concrete discovery question. For price concerns, ask budget and scope; do not invent a price. For integration concerns, ask vendor/version and API access. For a skeptical buyer, propose a scoped validation before commitment.
